findings.evidence: "If the skill reports that a file it needs is missing, it was installed without its folder: copy the whole directory to ~/.claude/skills/cal-e/." — the body references no bundled file (no references/, no scripts/), so this Gotcha item can never fire for this skill as shipped; it pads the Gotchas list the task never meets
findings.fix: Tie it to the purpose or remove it with a record row: replace it with a failure that can occur, e.g. "If the PR list comes back empty, re-check the range before reporting that nothing shipped: an inverted or wrong tag pair returns zero PRs that look like a quiet release", or delete the item and record the removal; keep the labels Gotcha that follows it

findings.evidence: No eval covers the dual-merge dedupe rule ("A PR merged to a release branch and to the main branch appears twice in a range: dedupe by PR number"), the docs-only PR rule, or the long-range handoff of step 7, so three of the skill's own rules are untested
findings.fix: Add a fifth eval whose range contains the same PR number twice (merged to release/4.2 and to main) plus a docs-only PR, with assertions such as "Each PR number appears in exactly one entry" and "The docs-only PR is left out"

findings.evidence: "Get the merged PRs of the range with the `gh` CLI or read the list the user pasted." — no branch for when gh is not installed, not authenticated, or the repo is hosted outside GitHub (GitLab, Gitea), which is the main approach failing with no fallback
findings.fix: Add one fallback sentence: "If `gh` is unavailable or the repo is not on GitHub, ask the user to paste `git log <start>..<end> --merges --oneline` output or the PR list, and derive PR numbers from the squash-merge subjects."
